title: Build 182 — Replies to comments
meta: backend on dev: migration 77, get-comments 2.0.6, post-comment 2.0.8
context: Comments under a post are now **threads, one level deep**. Replying to a reply stays in the same thread and names the person you answer.

items: “Reply” with a banner naming who you reply to; “↳ Name” when replying to someone other than the thread's author.
A “Comment deleted” placeholder for a first comment that has replies.
A push notification when someone replies to you.
Pull-to-refresh no longer duplicates the last comment after a failed load.

prerequisites: Build **182** or newer, iOS and Android; dev backend.
**Two accounts** (A and B) on two devices; notifications allowed for B.

scenarios.title: Reply to a comment
steps: A writes a comment under a post.
B taps “Reply” under it, writes a reply and sends it.
scenarios.expected: The reply appears under A's comment, indented with a thread line; the banner disappears.

scenarios.title: Reply to a reply
steps: A taps “Reply” under B's reply and sends a reply.
scenarios.expected: The new reply stays in the same thread and starts with “↳ B”.

scenarios.title: Push about a reply
scenarios.expected: B gets a push “A replied to you”; tapping it opens the post scrolled to the reply.

scenarios.title: Deleted first comment keeps its replies
steps: A deletes the comment that has replies.
scenarios.expected: “Comment deleted” takes its place; the replies stay underneath.

scenarios.title: Android: banner and keyboard
steps: On Android, tap “Reply”, then hide the keyboard with the back gesture.
scenarios.expected: The banner stays above the input; nothing is hidden behind the keyboard.

scenarios.title: Retry with pull-to-refresh
steps: Turn on airplane mode and open a post.
Turn it off and pull to refresh.
scenarios.expected: Comments load once, with no duplicates.

scenarios.title: Older backend — flat list
steps: On stg (old backend), open a post with replies.
scenarios.expected: Comments show as a flat list, oldest first; no thread lines, no errors.
